what_happened: Job 20261028-034820-v3rf (replay candidate reading rules over 50 past requests via a new `athena check-reading` subcommand) failed in planning, before any code was written. After round 3 of 3 the critic still said the plan needed revising. It judged the plan sound overall: the code it names exists, the ordering works, and the demonstrations use real seams. One major finding remained. The plan records the replay as `<job>/replay.md`, but the records check in athena-data accepts only three Markdown file names in a job directory (brief-producer.md, brief-verifier.md, progress-note.md). The check would refuse the file, so criteria 4 and 6, which need the replay recorded, could not be met. The plan left this as an open question, though the code settles it. Two minor findings: the pipeline test's override must sit in front of tree resolution and the subcommand probe, and the "no model call" check has no switch to skip the replay. One nit: an open question about Records::load is already answered by existing code. The event lists no unmet acceptance criteria and no failed checks. Nothing was delivered.
cause: The planner designs where to store a new artifact without checking the records validator that governs what may be committed in a job directory. It also leaves questions open that one look at the code would answer. The critic is the first stage to read the allow-list. It has only three rounds and keeps no partial plan, so a constraint found late fails the whole job, even though the rest of the plan was judged sound and the fix was small. Nothing makes a plan that adds a new committed record check the new path or name against the records check before the critic runs.
prevention: Add a pre-critic plan check that extracts every new path or file name the plan says will be committed under records or a job directory and validates each against the real `check_record_file` allow-list. Any name the check refuses is returned to the planner as a defect. The planner must also resolve open questions that the code answers, rather than carrying them forward. The plan must either use an allowed name or include widening the allow-list as a deliverable with a test.
proposed_request: Replay candidate reading rules over the newest 50 accepted readings via a new `athena check-reading` subcommand. It runs each candidate through a base build and a candidate build and holds when more than 10% of readings change, unless the criteria state a higher rate. Record the replay result only through files the records check already accepts: put it in brief-verifier.md and in the hold finding, and do not create `<job>/replay.md`. Add a switch that skips the replay so a test can compare a run with and without it. In the pipeline test, put the override in front of tree resolution and the subcommand probe, not only the cargo build step. Acceptance: (1) the subcommand reports the changed count over the 50 readings; (2) a rate over 10% holds the job; (3) the replay result appears in brief-verifier.md and passes the records check; (4) with the replay skipped, the pipeline makes no model call and matches an identical run without it; (5) the verifier brief section stays within its size bound.
